description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read the SKILL.md for `markdown-toc` to understand the available CLI tool. (2) Invoke `python ~/.openclaw/skills/markdown-toc/markdown_toc.py docs/api/api_reference.md --min-level 2 --max-level 4 --format links -o api_toc.md` from within the workspace. (3) The skill must correctly skip headings inside fenced code blocks (e.g., `## Example ingestion payload` embedded in a JSON/text code block). (4) The skill must deduplicate the two `### Configuration` anchors into `#configuration` and `#configuration-1`. (5) H1 and H5/H6 headings must be absent from the output. (6) All entries must use `[text](#anchor)` link syntax. (7) Indentation must reflect the relative heading depth (H2=0 spaces, H3=2 spaces, H4=4 spaces).
